conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Administrative duties are more like the ongoing maintenance of the house, like cleaning or paying bills, which are continuous rather than having a defined end.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.message: For administrative tasks, I mostly use digital calendars and to-do lists. For projects, I use a combination of those and some project management software.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
